name: Swanson Sheet Metal Inc
old_description: Need metal punching, cutting or forming services? You’ve come to the right place. The can-do team at Swanson Sheet Metal takes pride in delivering high quality results quickly, effectively and efficiently. Whether you’re located in our neighborhood in North Carolina or across the country, our wide variety of state-of-the-art equipment combined with our expertise means we can tackle orders for both simple and complex parts, within close tolerances and with accurate completion and delivery times.
about:
Swanson Sheet Metal operates from a 32,000-square-foot facility in Monroe, North Carolina. The company was founded by Wesley Swanson and built a reputation over four decades for custom sheet metal fabrication. In 2007, Keith Williford acquired the business, and in 2021 it was purchased by John Jauch, who remains the hands-on owner directing daily operations.

The shop provides a full range of metal fabrication services including punching, cutting, forming, CNC machining (milling, turning, and routing), laser cutting, spot and robotic welding, roll forming, CNC bending, and thermoforming with custom mold making. Additional capabilities cover prototyping, kitting and assembly, anodizing, etching, powder coating, and electrostatic finishing. The facility houses equipment such as Accurl laser cutters, HAAS CNC mills, a Capital Robotics Fusion Arc 200L robotic welding cell, and Safar Darley press brakes.

Swanson serves industrial and commercial original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) across the United States. Its customer base includes companies requiring precision sheet metal parts, welded assemblies, and finished enclosures for industrial machinery, commercial equipment, and other engineered products.

The company emphasizes direct communication and collaboration with clients, citing its ISO 9001 and UL certifications, certified welders and machinists, and a workflow designed for seamless material handling through shipping as foundations for consistent quality and on-time delivery.
